CITY OF WINDCREST BEXAR COUNTY, TEXAS' (digits illegible at source resolution); scale bar 0-100

qa_notes: STRUCTURE: the cover (p1) carries an 'INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY:' block (Type, Commence Date, Current Lease Rate, Price, Cap Rate, Term); transcribed as one 'Investment Opportunity' row with pairs, placed first because it precedes the p2 spec rows. Values kept in the original caps ('NET LEASED', '$109,800 / YEAR', 'RENEWED: through ...').
CAP RATE: $109,800 / $1,550,000 = 7.08%, which would round to 7.1%; PDF prints 7.0%. Rent has 'annual increases' so the figure may be stale either way - confirm with broker.

LEASE TERM: 'RENEWED: through Sept. 30, 2027' leaves about one year of term as of Sept 2026, while Comments still say 'Long term national credit tenant'. Broker should confirm the lease status before this goes out.

SIZE: PDF building 'Approximately 2,900 Square Feet'; Prismic size_label '2,898 SF' / size_total_sf 2898 (consistent; Prismic is the unrounded figure). Land 17,250 SF = 115 x 150 ft; 17,250 / 43,560 = 0.396 ac, printed '(.39 Acre)' (truncated, not rounded).

SITE PLAN (p7) shows side lot lines of 145.13' and 150.54' vs spec 'Depth: Approximately 150 feet'; its lot acreage box is illegible at the source resolution (reads roughly '.3?45 ACRES') and could not be checked against '.39 Acre'.
ZONING: PDF 'B1, Neighborhood Business District; City of Windcrest'; Prismic 'B1, City of Windcrest' (consistent, Prismic abbreviated).

CITY: cover prints 'SAN ANTONIO, TX' (abbreviated, kept as printed), but Location, Zoning and Comments all say the property is in the City of Windcrest and 'not subject to City of San Antonio ordinances'. Consider whether the cover city should read Windcrest.
TITLE matches Prismic ('5001 Walzem Road'). Prismic transaction_type is null; PDF cover says 'FOR SALE'.

Prismic highlights paraphrase comments: 'Rackspace Headquarters nearby.' vs PDF 'Rackspace Headquarters is nearby.'; Prismic omits the 'Long term national credit tenant' and Windcrest comments. Aerial maps label the building 'Rackspace Hosting' rather than headquarters.

DEMOGRAPHIC OVERVIEW TYPO: 3.0-mile Renter-Occupied printed '21.019' (period for comma); 21,540 + 21,019 = 42,559 = 2025 Households, so 21,019 is intended. Transcribed as printed. 1.0- and 5.0-mile owner+renter columns sum exactly.
Spec-page demographics table (106,591 / 292,094; $81,242 / $94,893) matches the Demographic Overview page. The spec table has no Source line (no note set).

BROKER ADDRESS inconsistency: disclosure page (p9) gives 'Building 2, Suite 206, 2338 North Loop 1604 W., San Antonio, Texas 78248'; both aerial maps show '18618 Tuscany Stone, Suite 200, San Antonio, TX 78258'; the other listings in this batch use '17721 Rogers Ranch Pkwy., Suite 125, San Antonio, Texas 78258'. Both addresses in this PDF look stale.
Cover photo signage reads 'CASH LOANS ON CAR TITLES' while the Tenant row names 'Welshire Financial Services' - not necessarily a conflict (d/b/a vs entity), noted for the broker.
Page footer disclaimer on pp1-2 and p7 misspells 'represetation'; template-wide, not transcribed.
